title: Measure what Matters: Psychometric Evaluation of AI with Situational Judgment Tests
reasoning: The paper explicitly states it evaluates AI systems in roles requiring 'emotional judgment and ethical consideration'. It utilizes the HEXACO psychometric model (which includes the 'Honesty-Humility' trait) and designs Situational Judgment Tests (SJTs) that specifically incorporate 'ethical and value-driven dilemmas' and 'ethical tension' as core components of its evaluation framework.
